messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Under the Machinery Directive, is the manufacturer required to affix the CE mark to the UR10e robot when it is delivered?

response.text: Ai sensi della Direttiva Macchine, il fabbricante è tenuto ad apporre la marcatura CE sul robot UR10e al momento della consegna?
